question: Who among the following was the 49th recipient of the Dadasaheb Phalke Award?
solution: The correct answer is __**Vinod Khanna.**__ __** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__** • Vinod Khanna was posthumously honoured with the **Dadasaheb Phalke Award at the 65th National Film Awards.** • Vinod Khanna was the** 49th recipient **of the Dadasaheb Phalke Award. • The Dadasaheb Phalke Award is **India's highest award in cinema.**
